how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DDA Young Professional Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 26-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DDA Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DDA Young Professional Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 26-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DDA Young Professional (GIS) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the DDA Young Professional (GIS) recruitment is 26-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional (GIS) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation Degree in Geographical Information System (GIS), Geoinformatics, Geo-spatial studies, or an equivalent course from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional (GIS) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional (GIS) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this DDA recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional (GIS) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Young Professional (GIS) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Young Professional (GIS) position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this DDA recruitment?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional (GIS) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article or from the DDA's official website.
